## ✅ Item 1 (real-backend browser verification) — DONE

Ran the full verification against a real stack: `framework@929efdf` app-showcase backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4010`, 42 plugins, seeded demo data) + this repo's console dev server (`VITE_SERVER_URL=` `DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010`, vite :5190), driven headless via Playwright/Chromium on `main` (post-#2546, commit `a56c596`). **All checks passed, 0 console errors on every page.**

| Shape | Object / record | Result |
|---|---|---|
| **grouped** | `showcase_semantic_zoo` "Zoo Alpha" | Highlights strip (name/status/amount) ✓, `record:path` Draft→**Active**→Done ✓, groups whose fields were all promoted to highlights correctly collapse away, ungrouped tail splits into primary + collapsible **"More details"** (notes) ✓, audit meta footer + discussion ✓ |
| **ungrouped** | `showcase_contact` "Nora West" (seeded) | Auto-derived highlights (phone/email/account) ✓, auto-detected path New→Working→**Qualified**→Closed ✓, Details/Related tabs ✓, flat field grid + "Show 1 empty fields" ✓ |
| **stageField:false** | `showcase_semantic_zoo_legacy` | **No `record:path` emitted** ✓ (status renders as a plain Green badge field), declared highlights (name/amount) ✓ |
| **related-heavy** | `showcase_account` "Northwind" | ADR-0085 prominence: **Invoices & Projects as own tabs** + aggregated **Related** tab ✓; related lists **self-fetch lazily** — exactly 1 child-data request fired only when the tab was clicked (the removed legacy path used to eager-fan-out all of them) ✓ |
| **authored page** (bonus) | `showcase_task` (task-detail.page) | Authored `PageSchema(record)` path renders custom Overview/Schedule/Details sections + Log Time action ✓ |
| **kill-switch inert** | same zoo record ± `?renderViaSchema=0` | Page structure byte-for-byte identical (path/More details/Edit/body length 565=565) — **the param is dead** ✓ |
| **`?tab=` contract** (#2257) | account → Projects tab → refresh | URL gains `?tab=related:showcase_project`; after reload the Projects tab is still selected ✓ |

Notes for reproducers: the runbook in the issue body works, with two corrections — (1) run `pnpm run setup` (plain `pnpm setup` triggers pnpm's built-in), then `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase...` so the oclif CLI has its `dist/commands`; (2) start the console with `VITE_SERVER_URL=` emptied (`.env.development` pins it to `:3000`, which breaks auth fetches when your backend is elsewhere).

Item 2 (framework-side stale `renderViaSchema` source comment) remains open — framework repo write access wasn't available from this session.

**Item 2 pinpointed** (from a framework@`929efdf` checkout) — the remaining cleanup is exactly one comment line:

- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:973` — the ADR-0085 removal note's last sentence, *"`renderViaSchema` retires together with the legacy monolith render path."* The render path is gone (objectui#2546), so this sentence can be dropped (or rephrased to past tense).

Not to be touched: `packages/spec/src/data/object.test.ts:1124` also mentions `renderViaSchema`, but that's the guard test "strips the removed detail block on safeParse" using a retired key as its representative legacy input — the behavior it protects (old metadata doesn't explode) is still valid.
